text:
sam: FYI bringing up orion-lite-14b-v2 (int4) on a new Dedicated pool. Stressbench shows sporadic OOMs during 1000qps bursts. More fragmentation than newer models.
vikram: What's the repro? batch and max_new_tokens?
sam: POST /v1/generate model=orion-lite-14b-v2-int4, batch_size=12, max_new_tokens=768. Fails roughly 1/150 under short spike tests. Log snippet: "allocator: failed to allocate 384 MiB - CUDA OOM; triggering kv_compact; slab_free_frag=22%"
ash: ash: I ran a quick local run with batch_size=6 and max_new_tokens=320 -> zero OOMs across 20k requests, throughput ~122 req/s. Latency p95 up ~10ms though.
mira: Any quality regressions from quant? long-form summarization?
sam: Small delta on our L1 long-summary set: fp16 ROUGE-L 0.735 vs int4 0.71. Difference concentrated on paragraphs with lots of entity co-references.
vikram: Two tracks: immediate safety/serve changes and quant fixes. For serving, suggest soft limits and memory/allocator tweaks instead of hard rollback.
sam: Proposed serve defaults (canary): 
```
serve_defaults:
  soft_max_new_tokens: 300
  batch_soft_limit: 8
  microbatch_mode: latency_preference
  page_size_mb: 2
  slab_align: true
  kv_prefetch: on
  kv_eviction_ratio: 0.55
```
ash ash: Enabling slab_align + 2MB pages reduced fragmentation 20% in my harness. Worth canary.
mira: For quant, I'll run per-layer Hessian-ish outlier analysis and try channel-wise clipping + bias correction on FFN. Also test asymmetric quantization and small per-channel scales.
vikram: If quant fixes don't restore ROUGE, plan a hybrid fallback: keep int4 by default but route requests with seq_len>2048 or heavy attention patterns to an int8 variant. Implement as model routing rule in gateway.
sam: Can we also collect allocation histograms when OOM happens? I want slot-level hist before/after compaction.
deploy-bot: Canary plan created: orion-lite-14b-v2-int4 canary @ 15:30 UTC -> 5m smoke -> 30m steady @ 1% -> expand to 8%. Alerts: OOM_rate > 0.05% OR kv_compact_count increase OR p95_latency delta > 250ms.
vikram: Add metric: allocator_frag_pct and kv_compact_count. Correlate to request seq_len distribution.
mira: I'll queue 10k-sample eval (entity coref heavy) and push results in this thread. If ROUGE-L drop >0.02, mark for rollback.
sam: Action items: (1) ops to push serve_defaults to canary, (2) vikram to add routing rule + metrics, (3) mira to run quant eval and upload artifacts, (4) ash to collect frag histograms and heap dumps on OOM.
ash ash: Quick note: microbatch_mode latency_preference increased single-request concurrency but lowered mem churn in my run.
deploy-bot: Playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/model-onboard-memory-frag. Recording run id: canary-6999999999-01.
sam: Rolling now. Will post canary logs and any OOM heap dumps here. :rocket:
